examples.japanese: ケーキを{半分|はんぶん}に{切|き}る。
examples.english: To cut the cake in half.

examples.japanese: {仕事|しごと}は{半分|はんぶん}{終|お}わった。

notes:
{半分|はんぶん} means 'half' as a noun, representing one of two equal parts.

COMPONENTS:
- {半|はん}: half
- {分|ぶん}: portion, part

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {半分|はんぶん}に{切|き}る (to cut in half)
- {半分|はんぶん}に{分|わ}ける (to divide in half)
- {半分|はんぶん}ずつ (half each)
- {半分|はんぶん}くらい (about half)
- {半分|はんぶん}も{残|のこ}っていない (not even half remains)

RELATED COMPOUNDS WITH {半|はん}:
- {半額|はんがく}: half price
- {半年|はんとし}: half a year, six months
- {半日|はんにち}: half a day
- {半数|はんすう}: half the number
- {半径|はんけい}: radius (half diameter)
- {半島|はんとう}: peninsula (half island)

CONTRAST:
- {半分|はんぶん}: half (noun - the half portion itself)
- {半|はん}: half (prefix - attaches to other words)
- {二分|にぶん}の{一|いち}: one-half (fractional expression)
